items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: George Gaynor stayed with us a long time... He can play pretty good banjo.

ctx.x: Was he with you long? How long did he...

Oh yeah, he stayed with us a long time. George Gaynor stayed until we just broke up almost. He just said so wild and crazy. He can play pretty good banjo. I don't like the ghetto playing. He hits that old banjo so hard. Johnny had to build their dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear…
Was there a guy killed on that same boat? Which boat was that? Huh? Which boat was this, anyway, that you played on? The steamer capitol. And was that a guy killed on the capitol?
